item.title: WVU Medicine Karen Bowling elected as WV Delegate to the American Hospital Association’s regional policy board
item.description: Mercer County, WV (WOAY) – WVU Medicine Princeton Community Hospital Karen Bowling has been elected as the West Virginia State Delegate to the American Hospital Association’s regional policy board. Bowling will work with other health care leaders from around the country to inform federal hospital policy development. She will serve a three-year term.
